verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents its own automatic user provisioning: changes to Workspace user accounts sync automatically to third-party apps, which covers the downstream app-assignment half of joiner/mover/leaver. Nothing shows an HRIS acting as the source of truth feeding the directory; the Directory and Cloud Identity APIs and Apps Script are only developer building blocks for that. Missing for 10: a native HRIS-to-directory inbound connector, documented automated mover/leaver handling driven by HR data, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, HR drives identity — the HRIS is the source of truth, and joiner/mover/leaver changes flow into the directory and app assignments automatically

citations.quote: אתם יכולים להגדיר הקצאת הרשאות אוטומטית למשתמשים כדי שכל השינויים שתבצעו בחשבונות המשתמשים ב-Google Workspace יסונכרנו אוטומטית עם אפליקציית הצד השלישי הזאת.
Puedes configurar el aprovisionamiento automático de usuarios para que los cambios que realices en las cuentas de usuario de Google Workspace se sincronicen automáticamente con esta app de terceros.
